description: upgrade to a higher room category
utterances: any chance i can get a bigger room for the rest of my stay
I booked a standard double but I'd like to know if a suite or junior suite is available and what the difference in price would be per night.

description: move to a different room on a higher floor
utterances: can you put me somewhere further from the street
The room I was given faces the main road and I hear traffic all night, could I be moved to the back of the building or higher up?

description: switch to a room that does not smell of smoke
utterances: this room reeks of cigarettes can i swap
I specifically asked for a non-smoking room when I reserved, but the one I've been given has a strong stale tobacco smell in the curtains and bedding.

description: check out later than the standard time
utterances: could i keep the room until mid afternoon tomorrow
I'm not leaving the city until the evening, so I was hoping to stay in the room a few hours past the usual departure time, is there a fee?

description: check in before the standard arrival time
utterances: i arrive early tomorrow morning can i get into my room before noon
We'll be arriving around eight in the morning and would really like access to the room straight away rather than waiting until the afternoon, is that possible?

description: add extra nights to the current stay
utterances: can i stay two more nights in the same room
My plans have changed and I need to remain in town until the weekend, is it possible to keep this room for three additional nights at the same rate?

description: leave earlier than the booked departure date
utterances: something came up i need to check out tomorrow instead
I originally reserved through Sunday but I have to head home two days sooner, will I still be charged for the nights I won't be using?

description: change the dates of an upcoming reservation
utterances: can i push my booking back a week
I have a booking for next month but the trip has been moved, I'd like to shift the whole stay forward by ten days if rooms are still available.

description: cancel an upcoming reservation
utterances: i need to drop my booking for next week
Unfortunately the trip has fallen through, so I'd like to call off the two-night stay I have booked and find out whether any cancellation fee applies.

description: add an extra bed to the room
utterances: we've got a third person can you bring in a rollaway
My colleague will be sharing the room with us for the last two nights, could you set up an additional single bed and let me know the extra charge?

description: get a baby cot placed in the room
utterances: do you have a crib for our infant
We're travelling with a six-month-old and need somewhere safe for her to sleep, is it possible to have a crib set up before we arrive this evening?

description: have housekeeping clean the room now
utterances: nobody has tidied our room yet today can someone come
We've been out all morning and the room still hasn't been made up, could you send someone to do the beds and empty the bins while we're at lunch?

description: skip housekeeping service for today
utterances: please don't send anyone to clean my room today
I'll be working from the room all day and would rather not be interrupted, so there's no need for anyone to come in and service it until tomorrow.

description: complain the room was left dirty after cleaning
utterances: the cleaner came but the bathroom is still a mess
Housekeeping supposedly serviced our room this morning, yet there's hair in the shower, the bin is full and the cups weren't replaced, this really isn't acceptable.

description: get fresh towels and toiletries delivered
utterances: can someone bring up some clean bath towels
We've run out of shampoo and the bath mats are damp from this morning, would you mind sending a replacement set of linen and bathroom amenities to the room?

description: get extra pillows or blankets
utterances: it's freezing in here can i get another duvet
The bed only has two rather thin pillows and my partner likes to sleep propped up, could you send a couple more along with a spare blanket?

description: report the air conditioning is not working
utterances: the aircon in my room is just blowing warm air
I've had the cooling unit set to its lowest setting for two hours and the room is still stifling, it seems to be broken, can an engineer take a look?

description: report there is no hot water in the bathroom
utterances: the shower is running cold and won't warm up
I've let the tap run for a good ten minutes this morning and it never gets past lukewarm, so I couldn't shower properly, is there a problem with the boiler?

description: report a leaking tap or blocked drain
utterances: water keeps pooling on the bathroom floor
The sink in our bathroom drains incredibly slowly and there's a steady drip under the basin that's soaked the cabinet, could maintenance come and sort it out?

description: report the television is not working
utterances: the tv won't turn on at all
The screen in our room just shows a no signal message on every channel and the remote doesn't seem to do anything, could someone come and fix it?

description: report the room wifi is not connecting
utterances: i can't get online from my room
My laptop connects to the network but every page times out, I've tried the password from the welcome card several times and it still won't load anything.

description: report the in-room safe will not open
utterances: the safe in the wardrobe is stuck shut with my passport inside
I locked my valuables in the little strongbox last night and now the keypad just beeps and refuses to release the door, can someone override it?

description: report the key card no longer opens the door
utterances: my room card stopped working after i went out
I've been tapping the card on the reader for five minutes and the light just flashes red, it worked fine this morning, could you reprogram it for me?

description: get an additional key card for a companion
utterances: can my wife get her own key so we don't share
My friend is joining me in the room tonight and will be coming and going separately, could you issue a second card so we're not dependent on each other?

description: store luggage after checking out
utterances: can i leave my bags here until this evening
We're checking out this morning but not leaving until late tonight, is there somewhere secure we could keep two suitcases while we explore the city?

description: collect luggage left in storage
utterances: i'm back for the suitcase i dropped off earlier
I left a backpack and a garment bag with the concierge this morning before heading out, I'm ready to pick them up now, what do you need from me?

description: get an invoice for the stay
utterances: can i get a printed receipt for the whole stay
I'm checking out tomorrow and need an itemised bill showing the room rate and taxes for each night so I can submit it to my employer for reimbursement.

description: add company details to the invoice
utterances: the bill needs my employer's name and tax number on it
The receipt you gave me at checkout is in my personal name, but accounting won't accept it unless it's issued to the business with its registered address.

description: dispute a minibar charge on the bill
utterances: i didn't touch anything in the fridge why am i being charged
My final statement lists two bottles of wine and some snacks from the room fridge, but we never opened it, could you please remove those items?

description: complain about noise from a neighbouring room
utterances: the people next door have been shouting for an hour
There's a party going on in the room across the hall with people yelling and doors slamming past midnight, could someone ask them to keep it down?

description: complain about noise from construction on the premises
utterances: there's drilling right above my room since seven this morning
Nobody mentioned the renovation on the floor above when I booked, the hammering starts at dawn and makes it impossible to rest, what are you going to do about it?

description: recover an item left behind in the room
utterances: i think i left my charger in the room i just vacated
I checked out yesterday and realised later that my watch is still on the bedside table, has housekeeping handed anything in and how can I get it back?
